en: Vintage monochrome postcard depicting a large, ornate brick railway station building with steep gabled roofs, dormer windows, and decorative stonework. People are walking along paths in a landscaped garden in front of the station, and several horse-drawn carriages are waiting near the entrance canopy. The printed caption at the top reads "NIJMEGEN Station", and along the right edge is publisher information.
